vocabulary.meaning_en: clothes for your hands

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tool that makes smoke to calm bees

vocabulary.meaning_en: a wooden part inside a hive where bees make honey

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move something up

vocabulary.meaning_en: a male bee

vocabulary.meaning_en: to produce eggs from the body

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sweet liquid inside flowers

vocabulary.meaning_en: a fine yellow powder from flowers

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small card with your name and work details

vocabulary.meaning_en: a toy figure you move with your hand or strings

vocabulary.meaning_en: afraid

fine_lines.title: Type 1 vs Type 2 conditionals
fine_lines.explanation_ar: النوع الأول: If + مضارع ... will (شيء حقيقي محتمل): If they don't eat, they won't live. النوع الثاني: If + ماضٍ ... would (شيء متخيَّل): If I wanted to help the bees, what would I do?
fine_lines.explanation_en: Type 1: If + present ... will (real and likely): If they don't eat, they won't live. Type 2: If + past ... would (imagined): If I wanted to help the bees, what would I do?

examples.sentence: If you practice, you will become better.
If I worked with bees, I would not need protective clothing.

fine_lines.title: scared vs scary
fine_lines.explanation_ar: scared = خائف (يصف شعور الشخص). scary = مخيف (يصف الشيء الذي يسبب الخوف).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Scared describes how a person feels. Scary describes the thing that causes the fear.

expressions.example: Thanks for coming. I'll let you see yourself out.

expressions.example: Bye, see you next week. Take care!

grammar.title: Conditionals: Type 1 and Type 2 (practice)
grammar.explanation_ar: النوع الأول: If + مضارع بسيط، will/won't + فعل، لشيء حقيقي نتيجته محتملة جدًا (If I use a smoker, the bees will stay calm). النوع الثاني: If + ماضٍ بسيط، would + فعل، لموقف متخيَّل أو غير مرجّح (If I worked with bees, I would not need protective clothing). في السؤال: If I wanted to help, what would I do? ويمكن استخدام صيغة الأمر في النتيجة: If you want to help bees, do those two things.
grammar.explanation_en: Type 1: If + present simple, will/won't + verb, for a real situation with a likely result. Type 2: If + past simple, would + verb, for an imagined situation. Questions: If I wanted to help, what would I do? You can also use an imperative: If you want to help bees, do those two things.
examples: If I use a smoker, the bees will stay calm.
If they don't eat, they won't live.
If I wanted to help the bees, what would I do?
If you practice, you will become better at them.
